name: Twin Pinks
source:
Kakizawa Tsubasa belongs to the Kendo club and anticipates an important match determining the scholarship the next day, but she is in a poor shape. Her twin brother with the same name and same looks also attends kendo club, but he's in perfect shape right now. Siblings decide to change places for the day of the match. Will this plan succeed?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
柿泽翼是剑道社成员，期待次日决定奖学金归属的重要比赛，却状态欠佳。与她同名同貌的双胞胎哥哥也参加剑道社，但状态正好。兄妹决定在比赛当天互换身份。计划能成功吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
